postings.title: Product Manager
postings.text:
Product Manager
Brightleaf Retail | Chicago, IL | Hybrid

About the role:
Brightleaf Retail is a (fictional) organisation building tools for checkout. As a Product Manager you will work with a small cross-functional team and see your work used in decisions every week.

Responsibilities:
- Own the roadmap for checkout and align it with company goals
- Prioritise the backlog together with engineering and design
- Coordinate launches with marketing, sales and support
- Communicate progress and risks to executives

Requirements:
- 3+ years of relevant experience
- Proven Product Management experience shipping software products
- Owning the product roadmap and making trade-offs explicit
- User research experience: interviews, surveys, usability studies
- Stakeholder management across business, design and engineering
- Agile delivery experience with engineering teams
- Prioritization frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW) and backlog prioritization
- Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or related field, or equivalent experience

Nice to have:
- Strong SQL skills: joins, window functions and CTEs on large tables
- Experience designing and reading A/B tests
